question: Can a tiny learned selector using only visible process features improve risk-constrained correct-map coverage over confidence thresholds?
feature_contract: source header and candidate target character n-grams
decision_rule: Nested pair-OOF logistic acceptance model; each outer threshold is selected only from inner OOF scores of other pairs under the risk and target-exact floors.
nonclaims: This is a tiny development selector, not LoRA, a student model or a confirmatory result.
The sealed Q3 labels are development references, not human gold or blind review.
The probe must not use gold fields as input features.
A positive result would justify a later student experiment only after an independent pair/source check.
